native_flow_notes: Sweet-Gum preserves live target counts, the ten-target selection cutoff, preexisting targets, the untargettable/unmark/counter order and the flash return.

Quest enables the milled trigger flag first, preserves humiliation checks before event dispatch, always calls the non-library graveyard helper, and retains both its optional/mandatory event bits and quest/global-enchantment return paths.
All four spell-interaction creatures return 99 for any nonzero spell availability and 1 otherwise while storing an exact 1/0 info slot; helper return magnitudes are not propagated on that path.
Mizzium retains failed-retarget validation and fresh target pair/index reads after callbacks. Muck retains mandatory ETB calls and the raw madness return outside CAN_CAST.

Frilled formats its prompt even when the info slot prevents the dialog, then reads the stack globals again after the dialog for countering. Naru validates the spell before checking the saved info slot, and preserves its raw counterspell return for the affected CAST path.
